meta.title: 2026 Brownlow Predictor
meta.description: Final pre-market 2026 Brownlow expected-votes model built from the completed human 3-2-1-0.5 tracker and calibrated model layer.

players.name: Brodie Grundy
players.note: 2025 showed raw hitout/ruck volume can massively overpredict Brownlow conversion.

players.name: Ed Richards
players.note: Six predicted BOG-type performances and a damaging, role-adjusted profile rather than cheap accumulation.

players.name: Harry Sheezel
players.note: High proportion of 1/0.5 calls creates marginal-vote conversion risk despite an excellent statistical floor.

players.name: Izak Rankine
players.note: High share of 3/2 calls, goals plus midfield and score impact; very little fringe dependence.

players.name: Jai Newcombe
players.note: Strong 3/2 concentration; contested, clearance and tackle profile is highly umpire-visible.

players.name: Jordan Dawson
players.note: Public model materially higher than the human tracker; upward uncertainty retained without forcing convergence.

players.name: Kysaiah Pickett
players.note: Midfield work plus goals and scoring damage create nonlinear Brownlow upside.

players.name: Luke Jackson
players.note: Hybrid ruck/mid/forward with repeated match-winning stretches, goals and around-ground impact. Deliberately avoids the 2025 raw-hitout trap.

players.name: Max Gawn
players.note: Elite around-ground ruck influence is rewarded through marks, clearances, goals and impact rather than hitouts alone.

players.name: Murphy Reid
players.note: Surprise-poller signal supported by Fremantle public predictor snapshots.

players.name: Nasiah Wanganeen-Milera
players.note: 2025 model materially undercalled him; 2026 intercept and score-involvement stat access should improve visibility.

players.name: Nick Daicos
players.note: Elite 3-vote concentration; the 2026 umpire stat sheet reinforces his contested, clearance and score-involvement games.
